title: Remapping Functionality donot detect  "." and contnuously shows ":"

judgment.rationale: The German-layout report says the Keyboard Manager key-capture field shows colon when the reporter tries to enter period; another user reports a similar difficulty. The text does not show whether the wrong symbol is only the editor's display or the saved physical key mapping, and the report is from 0.69.1.
evidence: The body gives a German-keyboard capture sequence and distinguishes period from Shift+period/colon.
The single comment reports a similar German keyboard issue while mapping comma to period.
The live issue has no assignee or linked fix; no current-version confirmation is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Clarify the physical key, displayed symbol, and saved mapping on a current build before identifying an editor or runtime defect.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current evidence does not establish whether the wrong symbol is a key-picker label/input-capture issue or a runtime remapping failure.

issue_context.summary: On a German keyboard, the remapping capture UI reportedly displays colon instead of period when the author tries to enter the period key.
known_information: Reported on PowerToys 0.69.1 from Microsoft Store, running as administrator.
The body says colon should be produced only by Shift+period.
A commenter reports a similar German-layout issue while trying to map comma to period.
No current build confirmation or linked fix is present.
inferences: The mismatch may be in key capture/display rather than the eventual remapped output, but the report does not distinguish these.
issue_context.analysis: A focused clarification of the physical key and resulting saved mapping is the needed evidence; a generic diagnostics upload is premature.
initial_investigation: Read the live body and the sole comment.
Checked current labels, assignees, and linked work; no direct fix is referenced.

information_gaps.information: Whether the key picker alone displays colon or whether the saved/runtime mapping also behaves as colon on a current build.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes keyboard-layout key identification from runtime remapping behavior.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On a current build, state the physical key pressed, the symbol shown in the capture UI, the saved source key, and the output when the mapping is invoked; identify the German layout variant.

actions.label: Separate capture display from runtime mapping

comment.body:
Thanks for describing the German-layout capture behavior and the similar comma-to-period report. The current issue does not show whether only the capture field displays `:` or whether the saved/runtime mapping also behaves as colon; the report is also on 0.69.1.

Please confirm whether this still occurs on a current PowerToys build and identify the German layout variant. For the physical key you press, state what the capture field displays, what source key is saved, and what output occurs when the mapping is invoked. This will distinguish key identification in the editor from runtime remapping.
